message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts. The case: forging military documents and using military vehicle plates. The prosecution says: "伪造武装部队证件罪、非法使用武装部队专用标志罪". So charges: 伪造武装部队证件罪 (forgery of armed forces documents) and 非法使用武装部队专用标志罪 (illegal use of armed forces special insignia). Possibly also "伪造军用车辆号牌罪"? But they mention illegal use of armed forces special marks. The standard Chinese criminal law includes: "伪造、变造武装部队证件、印章罪" (Article 280). And "非法使用武装部队专用标志、专用装具罪" (Article 281). So answer should list both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]伪造武装部队证件罪;非法使用武装部队专用标志罪<eoa>
